answers.ask: Should the neighbourhood read as bright and cartoony or modern and realistic?
answers.answer: Make the neighbourhood bright and cartoony, matching a simple fun building and dress-up game.

answers.ask: Does every player get their own empty plot to build on, or do they claim a pre-built house in a shared town?
answers.answer: Every player gets their own empty plot to build their house on.

answers.ask: How many house plots should the town hold?
answers.answer: The town should hold 8 house plots to keep the first map small and playable.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Roleplay & Avatar Sim map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Personalized Plots: Uniform, flat, square lot footprints on a strict grid where players cleanly spawn and build their own houses.

INCLUDE:
- Vehicle Road Network: Wide, flat, grid-aligned streets — 15 studs minimum one-way, 30 studs two-way — snaking between residential and commercial zones so vehicle meshes turn without clipping walls.
- Enterable Interior: Shops, homes, and venues players go inside.
- Town Square Core: A central, deliberately oversized gathering hub built to handle maximum avatar density without traffic jams.
